answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 165049 Country: India Title: Taharah of bedding or bed-sheet. Question: Due to wet dream some drop of sperm felled on bedding. After having wet dream I went to take ghusl. After coming back I saw some drop of liquid on bedding. That may be sperm or water. I am not confirm about that so what should I do with that bed sheet. How should we wash the bed sheet which have become impure. Answer ID: 165049 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 16/206/SN=04/1440) Semen is thick fluid and somewhat cloudy white in colour. If it gets smeared with clothes etc it can be felt by seeing or touching. The drops which you saw after bath, if you are sure that it was semen then the portion of the chuddar with which it is smeared shall be declared impure and it is mandatory to wash it; Salah will not be valid without washing it. Put the impure part under the tap and rub with hand and flow water until you are sure that the impurity is removed, Thus the chuddar will turn pure. You may also wash the chuddar in tub etc in a way that you wash it thrice with new water every time and wring each time. See: Dur Mukhtar with Shami 1/342, pub. Beirut, Ahsanul Fatawa 2/57, pub. Karachi). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
